name: Camera Editor
description: Cameras (war3map.w3c) in the terrain editor: create from the view, preview, move, aim, edit their values.

mcpTools.name: set_camera
mcpTools.description: Makes a camera of the map, or changes the one of that name, as one edit: the Cameras tab of the open terrain editor shows it at once, and the map script declares it as gg_cam_<name>. A new camera needs target; what isn't given starts as the game camera (rotation 90, angle of attack 304, distance 1650, field of view 70). Values the World Editor's Camera Properties wouldn't keep are refused. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

zOffset.description: Height of the target above the ground, -4096 to 4096.

angleOfAttack.description: Degrees, 0 to 360; 304 is the game camera, 270 straight down.

mcpTools.name: remove_camera
mcpTools.description: Removes a camera of the map, as one edit. Triggers that use it are not changed: list_problems shows them. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

mcpTools.name: list_cameras
mcpTools.description: The open map's cameras: name, target, height offset, rotation, angle of attack, distance, roll, field of view, far and near clipping; free: true for a free camera (its target is 1 unit in front of it). Triggers call them gg_cam_<name>.
